目标：PUA:Win32/Softcnapp 家族（WROberlay*.dll:
Target: PUA:Win32/Softcnapp family (WROberlay*.dll injecting adware).
It injects a DLL into newly started processes, making go / npm / mysqldump randomly exit with zero output.

Will do:
· Ask Defender to remove detected threats
· Delete every WROberlay* file under C:\Windows (renamed to .quarantine if locked)
· Clean the related CLSID and icon-overlay registry entries
· Restart Explorer to unload the injected DLL

Running EnvKit as administrator is recommended to avoid the UAC prompt. Reboot once afterwards.
